hook.name: LaunchFeeHook
hook.description: A trading fee hook for basepad v2 launch pools. Charges fees via return-delta on both the specified and unspecified swap sides. Supports QUOTE_ONLY (all fees in quote token) and TOKEN_ONLY (creator share in launch token, platform share in quote) modes, splitting fees between a fixed platform address (5%) and configurable creator recipients (95%). Parameters and recipients are immutable after pool registration.
